cues.en: This is the lock picking lawyer, and the video you're about to watch is the culmination of a series of events that started about six months ago. That's when Shane at the excellent YouTube channel, Stuff Made Here, posted a video build of an unpickable lock.
cues.zh: 我是开锁律师，你即将观看的视频，是一连串事件的最终成果，而这一切大约始于六个月前。那时，YouTube 优质频道 Stuff Made Here 的 Shane 发布了一个视频，打造了一把无法撬开的锁。

cues.en: That video, which I will link below, also challenged me to open it. I obviously accepted because the lock is here, but Shane wanted to improve his design first. And by improve,
cues.zh: 那个视频，我会在下方附上链接，他还挑战我去打开它。我 obviously 接受了，因为锁就在这里，但 Shane 想先改进他的设计。而所谓改进，

cues.en: he seems to have meant
cues.zh: 他似乎是指

cues.en: redesigned from the ground up because what I received was the original lock and a second lock which bore no internal resemblance to the first.
cues.zh: 从零开始重新设计，因为我收到的是原锁和另一把内部与第一把毫无相似之处的锁。

cues.en: And I have to say I had a great time with these because both mechanisms are to the best of my knowledge completely original and in my opinion quite good.
cues.zh: 我得说，这两把锁让我玩得很开心，因为据我所知，这两个机制都完全原创，而且在我看来相当不错。

cues.en: Fortunately for me though, Shane doesn't have a lot of experience with lock defeat methods so there were a few minor oversights that I was able to exploit.
cues.zh: 不过对我来说幸运的是，Shane 对开锁破解方法经验不多，所以有几处小疏忽让我得以利用。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: each of the issues I found can be fixed with very little effort which would result in formidable lock designs.
cues.zh: 我发现的每个问题都能轻易修复，修复后就会成为非常强大的锁设计。

cues.en: Before we pick these, I want to explain what I'm going to do so my actions don't look too cryptic
cues.zh: 在开始撬锁之前，我想解释一下我要做什么，这样我的动作才不会显得太神秘

cues.en: that will require some reference to the internals.
cues.zh: 这就需要提到一些内部结构。

cues.en: But if you want a detailed look at what's inside,
cues.zh: 但如果你想详细了解里面有什么，

cues.en: you need to check out the Stuff Made Here YouTube channel and all the appropriate links are below.
cues.zh: 你需要去看看 Stuff Made Here 的 YouTube 频道，所有相关链接都在下方。

cues.en: The first lock, this one, looks something like this on the inside.
cues.zh: 第一把锁，也就是这把，内部看起来是这样的。

cues.en: When you insert the key, the pins in contact with the key will lift these upper pins that are shown in gold.
cues.zh: 当你插入钥匙时，与钥匙接触的弹子会顶起这些金色的上弹子。

cues.en: Those pins then lock into place and rotate until they're in contact with this fin.
cues.zh: 这些弹子随后锁定到位并旋转，直到它们接触到这个鳍片。

cues.en: There are gates in the fin and only if these upper pins are in the correct position will they pass through.
cues.zh: 鳍片上有槽口，只有这些上弹子处于正确位置时才能穿过。

cues.en: Notably, however, when that test phase occurs, when those upper pins encounter the fins,
cues.zh: 但值得注意的是，当测试阶段发生时，当那些上弹子碰到鳍片时，

cues.en: they are no longer in contact with the key pins.
cues.zh: 它们已经不再与钥匙弹子接触了。

cues.en: That's what makes this unpickable in theory.
cues.zh: 这就是理论上无法撬开的原因。

cues.en: What I'm going to do is lift all of the upper pins as far as they will go,
cues.zh: 我要做的是把所有上弹子推到最高位置，

cues.en: lock them in place, rotate them until they're in contact with the fin,
cues.zh: 将它们锁定到位，旋转直到接触到鳍片，

cues.en: and then drop them down until they fall into their gates.
cues.zh: 然后放下它们，直到落入槽口中。

cues.en: It usually takes a few attempts for it to work, but the method seems to be reliable.
cues.zh: 通常需要尝试几次才能成功，但这个方法似乎很可靠。

cues.en: The second lock is even more complex than the first. It actually has two cores attached with an internal connecting rod.
cues.zh: 第二把锁比第一把更复杂。它实际上有两个锁芯，通过一根内部连接杆相连。

cues.en: If we look at the back, we can see the bottom core, the top core, and a connecting rod.
cues.zh: 如果我们看背面，可以看到下锁芯、上锁芯和一根连接杆。

cues.en: The sheer line that matters is the one on the upper core which we can't access to tension.
cues.zh: 关键的分界线在上锁芯上，而我们无法接触到它来施加张力。

cues.en: It's behind this area of the lock.
cues.zh: 它在锁的这个区域后面。

cues.en: By the time that upper core actually turns, the bottom core is offset by about 45 degrees which means you can't move the pins.
cues.zh: 当上锁芯真正转动时，下锁芯已经偏移了大约45度，这意味着你无法移动弹子。

cues.en: That's why this lock is, at least in theory, unpickable.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么这把锁至少在理论上无法撬开。

cues.en: Put differently, when you can access the pins, can't tension the lock. When you can tension it, you can't access the pins.
cues.zh: 换句话说，当你能碰到弹子时，就没法给锁施加张力。当你能施加张力时，又碰不到弹子。

cues.en: I'm going to try to get around that by inserting a thin piece of metal between the door and the lock housing.
cues.zh: 我打算在门和锁壳之间插入一片薄金属来绕过这个问题。

cues.en: Then slide it up until
cues.zh: 然后把它向上滑，直到

cues.en: we're over the top of that upper core
cues.zh: 我们越过上方那个上弹子的顶部

cues.en: and then pull down which should tension the upper core.
cues.zh: 再往下拉，这样应该能给上弹子施加张力。

cues.en: Once that happens I should be able to pick this as I would a normal lock.
cues.zh: 一旦做到这一点，我就能像开普通锁一样把它撬开。

cues.en: There are two other potential vulnerabilities.
cues.zh: 还有另外两个潜在的漏洞。

cues.en: The first arises from a combination
cues.zh: 第一个源于一种组合

cues.en: of this core
cues.zh: 这个锁芯

cues.en: rotating 45 degrees in either direction until it seizes up
cues.zh: 向任一方向旋转45度直到卡住

cues.en: and the tailpiece being misclocked
cues.zh: 以及尾件被错位

cues.en: by about 45 degrees.
cues.zh: 大约45度。

cues.en: When we pick you'll see why that makes a difference but I think you'll get a chuckle when you see how they interact.
cues.zh: 撬锁时你会明白为什么这会有影响，不过我想你看到它们如何相互作用时会会心一笑。

cues.en: The second vulnerability
cues.zh: 第二个漏洞

cues.en: is decoding
cues.zh: 是解码

cues.en: and we can do that because all of these upper driver pins are the same length.
cues.zh: 我们能这么做是因为所有这些上驱动弹子长度都相同。

cues.en: A tool can be fashioned to lift all the pin stacks to the stopping point fully compressing the springs.
cues.zh: 可以制作一个工具，把所有弹子组抬到停止点，完全压缩弹簧。

cues.en: That's an indirect way of measuring the key pins which would allow us to cut a key.
cues.zh: 这是一种间接测量钥匙弹子的方法，能让我们据此切出一把钥匙。

cues.en: I did not create that tool because I had another way to open this but that's something used to be common before manufacturers
cues.zh: 我没有做那个工具，因为我有另一种方法打开它，但那在制造商

cues.en: started varying these lengths.
cues.zh: 开始改变这些长度之前曾经很常见。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I have been talking for too long.
cues.zh: 我讲得太久了。

cues.en: The jig that Shane sent me to pick these in is way too big to fit on my desk so we are going to mount these up, head down to the garage, and try to open them.
cues.zh: Shane 寄给我用来撬这些锁的夹具太大了，放不下我的桌子，所以我们打算把这些装好，去车库，试着把它们打开。

cues.en: Okay. We are down in the garage. Both locks are mounted in this mock door, and the frame is secured to my workbench.
cues.zh: 好，我们在车库里。两把锁都装在这扇模拟门上，门框固定在我的工作台上。

cues.en: We're going to start with the newer of the two locks and discuss a vulnerability
cues.zh: 我们先从两把锁中较新的那把开始，讨论一个漏洞

cues.en: enabled by the fact that this core will turn about 45 degrees before it seizes.
cues.zh: 这个漏洞的前提是，锁芯在卡死之前会转动大约45度。

cues.en: That creates an issue as the lock interacts with the deadbolt.
cues.zh: 这就产生了问题，因为锁会与锁舌相互作用。

cues.en: Now under normal circumstances,
cues.zh: 正常情况下，

cues.en: a deadbolt that is fully extended can't be pushed back into the door.
cues.zh: 完全伸出的锁舌是无法被推回门里的。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: if we turn this core as far as it will go, it's just enough to disengage the anti retraction mechanism.
cues.zh: 如果我们把锁芯转到极限，就刚好足以让防回缩机构脱开。

cues.en: That's something we can certainly take advantage of while the door is locked.
cues.zh: 这正是我们在门锁着时可以加以利用的。

cues.en: All we need to do that is something that will turn the core
cues.zh: 我们需要的只是一个能转动锁芯的东西

cues.en: and something pointy like the tip of my pocket knife.
cues.zh: 再加一个尖的东西，比如我口袋刀的刀尖。

cues.en: So going to turn this as far as it will go,
cues.zh: 那就把它转到极限，

cues.en: then use the point of the knife
cues.zh: 然后用刀尖

cues.en: to walk the bolt back.
cues.zh: 把锁舌一点点拨回去。

cues.en: Might as well let him know we're here.
cues.zh: 顺便让他知道我们在这儿。

cues.en: Next, we are going to attempt a picking attack, though certainly not a traditional one.
cues.zh: 接下来，我们要尝试一种开锁攻击，不过绝对不是传统的那种。

cues.en: We discussed it upstairs, but what I'm going to do is
cues.zh: 我们在楼上讨论过了，我要做的是

cues.en: attempt to slip this between the door and the housing so we can tension the upper core.
cues.zh: 把这个东西塞进门和外壳之间，好给上面的锁芯施加张力。

cues.en: Pushing this in will do damage to the door. However, I don't think it'll be a lot of damage, and I don't think it'll be very noticeable because it'll be on the bottom. However, I will show you the damage after we're done. The hard part will be getting this into position,
cues.zh: 把它推进去会损伤门。不过我觉得损伤不会很大，也不会很明显，因为它在底部。不过做完之后我会给你们看损伤情况。难的部分是把它弄到位，

cues.en: so let's do that now.
cues.zh: 那我们现在就来弄吧。

cues.en: I am pushing the tool against the door so it doesn't deform.
cues.zh: 我正把工具顶住门，免得门变形。

cues.en: Okay, I might have it, but the only way to be sure is to pull on these pliers
cues.zh: 好，我可能搞定了，但要确认只能拉一下这把钳子

cues.en: and see if the pins are binding.
cues.zh: 看看销子是不是卡住了。

cues.en: There we go. Click out of one. Little click on two.
cues.zh: 好了。一个开了。第二个轻轻一响。

cues.en: Nothing on three.
cues.zh: 第三个没动静。

cues.en: Little click on four.
cues.zh: 第四个轻轻一响。

cues.en: Little click on 5.
cues.zh: 第五个轻轻一响。
一，

cues.en: two, another click on 3.
cues.zh: 二，第三个又响了一下。

cues.en: Click on 4.
cues.zh: 第四个响了。

cues.en: Nothing on 5.
cues.zh: 第五个没动静。

cues.en: I don't feel anything else. Let's see if we have this open.
cues.zh: 我感觉不到别的了。看看能不能打开。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Now let's work on the older lock. Once again, I discussed the theory of what we're going to be doing while we were upstairs.
cues.zh: 现在来处理那把旧锁。再说一次，刚才在楼上我已经讲过我们要做的原理。

cues.en: However, it's a little bit harder in practice.
cues.zh: 不过实际操作起来会难一点。

cues.en: First, need to lock it.
cues.zh: 首先，得把它锁上。

cues.en: Okay. I'm going to use this pick to lift all the pins to their highest position,
cues.zh: 好。我要用这把撬锁工具把所有销子顶到最高位置，

cues.en: and when I release these,
cues.zh: 然后松开它们的时候，

cues.en: I'm going to be tapping on the housing
cues.zh: 我会敲击锁体

cues.en: with this mallet. It allows for a little bit more control as the pins come down,
cues.zh: 用这把小木槌。这样销子回落时能控制得更好一点，

cues.en: and it increases the chances of success from
cues.zh: 也能把成功率从

cues.en: about one in every ten times to one in every two or three.
cues.zh: 大概十次一次提高到两三次一次。

cues.en: I think we've got it.
cues.zh: 我觉得搞定了。

cues.en: Okay, folks. Let's bring all this stuff back upstairs. I will show you the damage underneath,
cues.zh: 好了，各位。把东西都搬回楼上吧。我给你们看看下面的损伤，

cues.en: and we will sum everything up. Okay, folks. We are back upstairs and I'm going to briefly address how to fix each of the exploits I demonstrated,
cues.zh: 然后我们总结一下。好了，各位。回到楼上了，我简单说说怎么修复我演示的每个漏洞利用，

cues.en: but first, let's take a look at the damage to the door.
cues.zh: 不过先看看门上的损伤。

cues.en: It's certainly noticeable once the lock is removed though much of the damage is covered by the lock and the part that isn't is probably obscured because it's underneath the bulky housing.
cues.zh: 锁拆掉后确实很明显，虽然大部分损伤被锁盖住了，没盖住的部分可能也因为在外壳下面而不太看得见。

cues.en: Frankly, even if I saw that I'd probably attribute it to sloppy installation and not to an attack.
cues.zh: 说实话，就算我看到了，大概也只会怪自己安装马虎，不会想到是攻击。

cues.en: While we're looking at the door, note that Shane welded both of the hinge pins
cues.zh: 看门的时候注意一下，Shane把两个铰链销都焊死了

cues.en: probably to stop me from popping the pins and declaring victory.
cues.zh: 大概是为了防止我把销子撬出来然后宣布胜利。

cues.en: And I've gotta say he did the right thing because I definitely would have done that.
cues.zh: 不得不说，他做得对，因为我肯定会那么干。

cues.en: Moving on to the locks, the issue with the first lock can be fixed easily by decreasing the angle of the fins so there's no slope them to rest on, frankly a reverse rake would probably be advisable.
cues.zh: 接下来看锁，第一把锁的问题很好解决，只要把锁齿的角度调小，让它们没有可供搭靠的斜面就行，说实话，反向后倾可能更合适。

cues.en: With the second lock, the first exploit can be fixed with a slight modification to this moving tailpiece
cues.zh: 第二把锁，第一个漏洞可以通过微调这个活动尾片来修复

cues.en: reclocking that cutout by about 45 degrees.
cues.zh: 把那个开口重新定位大约45度。

cues.en: There are about a dozen ways to fix the picking exploit and deny access to the back of the lock, but when I told Shane about it, he precision machined a back cover which is probably the most expensive solution but certainly one that works.
cues.zh: 开锁漏洞大概有十几种修法，都能挡住通往锁后部的路，但我跟Shane说了之后，他精密加工了一个后盖，这大概是最贵的方案，但肯定管用。

cues.en: So I hope you all enjoyed this. Shane, excellent work on these locks and thank you so much for sending them my way. To everyone else that's all I have for you today. If you do have any questions or comments about this please put them below. If you like this video and would like to see more like it, please subscribe.
cues.zh: 希望大家喜欢这期内容。Shane，这几把锁做得太棒了，非常感谢你寄给我。对其他所有人来说，今天就到这里。如果对此有任何问题或评论，请在下方留言。如果你喜欢这个视频，想看更多类似内容，请订阅。

cues.en: And as always, have a nice day. Thank you.
cues.zh: 一如既往，祝你过得愉快。谢谢。
